title: Hackfest-2021
content:
Hackfest-2021

Department of Computer Science and Engineering

Under CSI Student Branch

Presents

Hackfest-2021

  Two days National level Hackathon (Online) on 2nd & 3rd July 2021   Last Date for Registration 28-6-21   Cash prize: First: 8000/- second: 4000/-   Registration fee: Rs. 200/- per team * Teams should consist of 2 to 3 members   Objectives: 
  • To provide space for students to showcase their technical skills.
  • To provide a platform for creating solutions for social causes.
  • To inculcate teamwork spirit among students.
